operations.description: DMD-based MSIM with sCMOS detection and ET500lp filter; the source lists 60x water/NA1.27 and 100x Si-oil/NA1.35 objectives without assigning one to every panel. Pixel reassignment, pinholing, scaling, summing and deconvolution are described. A 1/90 telescope gives approximately 120 nm pixels. No experimental trace is fabricated.

quality.review_scope: Source-scoped InP core and InP/ZnSe/ZnS multishell preparation, ligand transfer, streptavidin/chitosan coupling, biological specimen preparation, and distinct source-reported characterization and control contexts. All eleven main and four matching supporting-information pages were read as text and images. Printed ambiguities, unspecified preparation settings, and unknown physical batch joins remain explicit. This is not a complete laboratory SOP or a full-paper narrative Reader.
missing_fields: Exact physical batch identity and unreported source conditions remain unknown.
Antibody stock titers, exact buffer recipes, PBST Tween concentration and per-panel laser power.
